properties.statement: Answered "has this project drifted away from its original purpose over time?" by hand: read the predecessor project's founding documents directly, fanned five independent readers over the rest of its repository to extract stated purpose, principles, warnings and self-admitted drift with quotes, then compared that against this design's own graph (which requirements from the predecessor were accepted, dropped, or left proposed; usage share, tool counts, verification execution, status fields). No served tool compares a design's stated intent over time or against a predecessor's; find_tools for the question returned set_project_mode, compare_designs and coverage_report, none of which asks it.
